lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone swore light was tiny bullets—until two beams crossed and created darkness.

lines.speaker: huygens
lines.text: Then watch it bend like ripples, Sir Isaac.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In 1678, Christiaan Huygens proved every point on a wavefront sparks fresh baby ripples—forming interference.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside Iceland spar crystal, one beam splits in two!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He also built the pendulum clock and unveiled Saturn's rings with wave-honed lenses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lasers, Wi-Fi, and 5G today? All surfing Huygens' waves.
